title: Blocked review result decision
description: A delivered worker result whose review stops blocked stays at an actionable result decision. The isolated production REVIEW boundary and hold preserve its reason, findings, owned slot and checkout; an authenticated GatewayClient verifies the pending decision and available actions. No model runs.

blocked-review.intent: Stop a delivered fixture review with residual findings, hold it for a result decision, and verify needs-decision, send-back/close, preserved reason/findings and pending later steps through authenticated RPC without a worker or publication.
